target_problem: construct exact-stretch missing outputs for switching-unbalanced signed-majority NC0_3 circuits using target-selectable 2-SAT implications beyond affine-hull and functional-anchor compression
conditional_implication: If a simple connected bicyclic component of the canonical first-two-variable pair graph has a barbell or figure-eight 2-core whose two edge-disjoint cycles both have odd signed transport, then output targets can be chosen so the exact majority constraints contain a contradictory 2-SAT implication SCC; the component and missing output are detected and constructed in deterministic polynomial time.
frontier_reason: The strict exact-stretch family has no proper positive-surplus subcircuit, fails V98 switching balance, has lambda=mu=nu=eta_AF=n and beta=floor(2n/3), while the V105 signed-barbell certificate is polynomial-time constructive. The support shape itself has direct 2GraphSAT prior art; the new laboratory object is compatibility with majority-induced complementary pair clauses.

bridge_lemmas.name: a fixed signed-majority target contains three exact binary 2-CNF clauses
canonical pair clauses realize a signed transport implication for either chosen source polarity
odd transport around any canonical pair cycle flips the propagated source polarity
two edge-disjoint odd cycles in a barbell or figure-eight create a contradictory implication SCC with compatible targets
simple connected bicyclic pair components can be classified by leaf pruning and degree/path tracing into barbell, figure-eight, or theta cores
odd barbell and figure-eight components are polynomially detected and targeted
the strict family is exact stretch, switching-unbalanced, and has no proper positive-surplus output subset
the strict family has beta=floor(2n/3), nu=n, and eta_AF=n
the four Karve-Hirani obstruction skeletons have exact majority-pair sign compatibility conditions 8/16/32/48
every simple bicyclic theta component admits a majority-target contradiction when all three clauses per gate are used
all signed-majority NC0_3-Avoid with m>n is polynomial time

closed_route: reordering functional-anchor and affine-hull primitives on signed majority; pair-edge surplus alone as a universal 2-SAT certificate
surviving_route: target-compatible implication minors on theta/K4/K1,1,3 cores and use of all three majority pair clauses per output
current_gap: The polynomial detector covers simple bicyclic odd barbells and figure-eights. Theta cores and more general canonical-pair components can avoid this certificate, and arbitrary signed-majority exact-stretch circuits remain open.
stop_rule: Do not promote V106 for another fixed barbell variant. Require a target-compatibility theorem covering a genuinely new obstruction core, a structural forcing theorem at exact stretch, or a rigorous obstruction/hardness result for the remaining signed-majority target-selection problem.
external_validation_target: prior-art review of signed-majority range avoidance, Karve-Hirani GraphSAT obstructions with restricted complementary edge clauses, selectable 2-SAT implication graphs, signed graph barbells, and Boolean CSP orientation obstructions
